observation: The first complete self-shape lifecycle reached a green close gate with a blind-spot report in warn state. The report had two concrete findings: recall outcome close-out had not yet been logged and the checkpoint text did not contain a recognized review-blindspots marker. Reordering close-out and recording an explicit review checkpoint changed the final deterministic review to ok with zero findings.

evidence.summary: The initial deterministic review reported two warnings. After log-outcome and an explicit review blindspots checkpoint were recorded before the final review, the final CI evidence reported status ok with zero findings and workflow close completed without accepted risk.

hypothesis: A self-review performed before its own outcome and review evidence are recorded can only review an incomplete lifecycle and may turn expected missing close-out evidence into tolerated warnings.
validated_conclusion: Run an exploratory blind-spot review before close-out if useful, then record outcome and an explicit review checkpoint, and require a final blind-spot review to exit clean before workflow close. Do not normalize warn as the final success state.
